title: Great bed frame
text: Great bed frame. Husband reports that the frame was easy to assemble and it's very sturdy! Would definitely recommend it! Great for storage below the bed too.

product_metadata.title: zizin Queen Size Bed Frame Platform Base 14 Inch with Storage/Heavy Duty Metal Beds Frames/Easy Assembly/Noise-Free/No Box Spring Needed (Queen)
features: 【Heavey Duty】 Bed frame queen is strong with sturdy steel slats support, can hold up to 3000 pounds.

【Noise Reduction】 The square metal steel structure is upgraded to reduce the friction with the mattress. The matching bedstead structure can effectively reduce the noise and provide you with comfortable sleep.
【No Box Spring Required】 Platform bed frame can match standard twin full queen king cal-king size mattress.
【Under Bed Storage】 The 14 inches high black bed frame with 12 inches of clearance storage space underneath the bed.
【Easy Assembly】 Zizin bed frame has integrated compact design, can be set up in minutes, all hardwares and tools included.
